definitions.explanation: More than what is necessary, normal, or desirable.

examples.japanese: {過剰|かじょう}な{期待|きたい}はしない{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better not to have excessive expectations.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}{過剰|かじょう}で{値下|ねさ}げした。
examples.english: We lowered prices due to excess inventory.

examples.japanese: {過剰|かじょう}な{自信|じしん}は{失敗|しっぱい}のもとだ。
examples.english: Excessive confidence is the source of failure.

notes:
USAGE: {過剰|かじょう} indicates an undesirable amount of something.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{過剰|かじょう}{生産|せいさん} (overproduction)
・{過剰|かじょう}{摂取|せっしゅ} (excessive intake)
・{過剰|かじょう}{反応|はんのう} (overreaction)
・{過剰|かじょう}{包装|ほうそう} (excessive packaging)
・{人口|じんこう}{過剰|かじょう} (overpopulation)
・{供給|きょうきゅう}{過剰|かじょう} (oversupply)

GRAMMAR: Used as na-adjective ({過剰|かじょう}な〜) or as noun suffix.

CONTRAST:
・{不足|ふそく} - shortage, deficiency (opposite)
・{適度|てきど} - moderate (appropriate amount)
